summary: Asobo Studio and Codemasters' 2009 open-world post-apocalyptic racer, notable for its huge free-roam map, dynamic weather, and mixed vehicle classes across Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360.

entries.title: Fuel

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows for the main route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Fuel released on PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Windows. The Windows version is the highest-fidelity configurable route for Asobo's massive free-roam off-road racer, whose map was publicized for its unusually large playable area.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS3 or Xbox 360 as console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.
